editorial.title: An Expression of Individuality.
editorial.text: Thoughtfully selected pieces for those who appreciate quality, detail, and timeless design.

story.title: Fashion Is Personal.
story.p1: CELESTIA began with a simple belief: the clothes you choose should feel unmistakably yours. We curate a focused wardrobe — tailoring with structure, knitwear with softness, accessories with purpose — rather than an endless catalogue.
story.p2: Every piece is chosen for its cloth, its cut and its ability to last beyond a single season. We favour natural fibres, honest construction and colours that work together, so a wardrobe can grow with you over years.
story.p3: And because the experience matters as much as the garment, we offer considered service from the first click to the moment your parcel arrives.

values.curationText: A focused edit, never an endless feed.
values.serviceText: Personal care from order to delivery.
